description: This file defines the OA_Dll class, which provides validation, permission checks, and utility functions for the domain logic layer of the Revive Adserver project. It includes constants for entity statuses, methods for email validation, structure validation, date order checking, database record existence, user credential validation, and permission management.

classes.name: OA_Dll
classes.description: Base class for domain logic layer, providing validation and permission management functions.

methods.name: checkEmail
methods.description: Validates an email address using a regex pattern.

methods.name: checkStructureRequiredStringField
methods.description: Checks if a required string field exists and is within max length.

methods.name: checkStructureNotRequiredStringField
methods.description: Checks if an optional string field exists and is within max length.

methods.name: checkStructureRequiredIntegerField
methods.description: Checks if a required integer field exists.

methods.name: checkStructureNotRequiredIntegerField
methods.description: Checks if an optional integer field exists and is of type integer.

methods.name: checkStructureRequiredDoubleField
methods.description: Checks if a required double (float) field exists.

methods.name: checkStructureNotRequiredDoubleField
methods.description: Checks if an optional double (float) field exists and is of type float.

methods.name: checkStructureRequiredBooleanField
methods.description: Checks if a required boolean field exists and is boolean.

methods.name: checkStructureNotRequiredBooleanField
methods.description: Checks if an optional boolean field exists and is boolean.

methods.name: checkDateOrder
methods.description: Verifies that the start date is not after the end date.

methods.name: checkIdExistence
methods.description: Checks if a record with given ID exists in specified table.

methods.name: validateUsernamePassword
methods.description: Validates username and password for basic rules.

methods.name: checkPermissions
methods.description: Verifies user permissions for accessing specific resources.

methods.name: getDefaultAgencyId
methods.description: Returns the default agency ID from permissions.

methods.name: checkAgencyPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the user has permissions for a specific agency.
